title: Cart page shows added items with correct details
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user, at least one item added to cart
steps: Verify cart item list shows added product(s)
Verify each item has name, description, price, quantity, and remove button
expected: Cart items display correctly with all details; quantity is 1

title: Remove item from cart page works
preconditions: Cart has at least one item
steps: Click Remove button on an item
Verify item is removed from cart list
expected: Item removed from cart; badge count decrements or disappears

title: Checkout button navigates to checkout step one
preconditions: Cart has at least one item, on /cart.html
steps: Verify checkout form with firstName, lastName, postalCode fields
expected: Checkout step one page displayed with input fields
